description: Machine-readable enforcement matrix for every vault standing rule and ledger decision. The heartbeat escalation-coverage canary joins this file against the live vault on every tick (fleet-ops#383). status is enforced | queued(#issue) | advisory(reason). advisory requires a senior-judged reason and is never the default. queued_stale_days is the age after which a queued row goes LOUD.
